title: File Upload and Format Detection
description: Verify the system correctly uploads local CSV, Parquet, and JSON files and auto-detects file format including handling of delimiter and encoding inference for CSV.

steps.description: Open the frontend UI and upload a CSV file without specifying format.
Verify the system detects the file as CSV and correctly infers delimiter and encoding.
Upload a Parquet data file.
Verify the system detects the file as Parquet and parses schema via pyarrow.
Upload a line-delimited JSON file.
Verify the file is detected as JSON and parsed accordingly.
Upload a large CSV file beyond recommended size.
Verify appropriate large file warning is displayed and sampling limits are enforced.

title: Data Inspection and Sampling Controls
description: Verify schema inference, data sampling strategies (head, tail, random), and profiling are displayed correctly in the inspect panel.

steps.description: Upload a sample CSV file.
View schema and sample rows in the inspect panel.
Verify schema matches the dataset and sample rows correspond to the sampling strategy 'head' by default.
Change sampling strategy to 'tail'.
Verify sample rows shown correspond to the tail of the data.
Change sampling strategy to 'random' and adjust row limits.
Verify random samples of requested size are displayed.
Check displayed profiling statistics for columns.
Verify basic profiling metrics (e.g., count, unique, mean) are accurate.

title: Python Script Generation with LLM
description: Verify deterministic and reproducible Python script generation configured by analysis engine (pandas or polars) and visualization library (plotly or seaborn).

steps.description: Trigger Python script generation for a given dataset with default configuration.
Verify the generated script matches expected template and is deterministic upon repeated requests.
Set configuration to use polars engine and seaborn visualizations.
Generate Python script.
Verify output script uses polars and seaborn libraries accordingly.
Save generated script and verify it can be copied or downloaded.
Verify saved script matches generated content exactly.

title: Script Execution and Report Generation
description: Verify execution of generated Python scripts in isolated environments produces HTML reports and individual image artifacts with live streaming logs.

steps.description: Execute a generated Python script via backend execute API.
Verify isolated environment is used for execution and no contamination occurs.
Verify live execution logs stream correctly and are displayed in frontend.
Verify HTML report and image artifacts are generated and linked in results panel.
Attempt to execute a script with intentional errors.
Verify error is caught and displayed gracefully without crashing frontend.

title: Frontend UI Accessibility and Keyboard Navigation
description: Verify the entire frontend UI supports accessible keyboard navigation, proper ARIA labels, and correct focus order.

steps.description: Navigate through the file upload controls, sampling selector, script generation button, and results panel using keyboard only.
Verify focus order is logical and consistent.
Verify all interactive elements have ARIA labels and roles.
Verify no keyboard traps or focus loss.

title: Backend API Communication and Contract Testing
description: Verify the backend APIs for inspect, generate, and execute communicate correctly with the frontend and maintain contract correctness including payload formats and streaming behavior.

steps.description: Trigger file inspection via frontend and verify inspect API request payload.
Verify inspect API response contains correct schema and sampling data.
Request script generation via frontend and monitor generate API request and response.
Verify generated script payload matches expected format.
Execute generated script and observe execute API request including isolated environment handling.
Verify execution logs are streamed and end with final report artifacts info.

title: Privacy and Security Validation
description: Verify that network egress is prevented by default and that temporary files and paths are properly sanitized and cleaned up post execution.

steps.description: Perform script execution with environment variables set to disable external model providers.
Verify no outbound network calls occur during execution.
Check cleanup process after script execution completes.
Verify all temporary files and directories created for analysis and reports are deleted.

title: Performance under Large Data Loads
description: Verify performance with virtualized tables, debounced prompt recompositions, and streamed logs work smoothly when dealing with large sample datasets.

steps.description: Upload a large CSV dataset that triggers virtualized table rendering.
Verify smooth scrolling and fast rendering of sample rows.
Change sampling strategy repeatedly and observe debounce effectiveness on re-inspection / prompt recomposition.
Verify UI remains responsive and does not freeze or excessively reload.
Run a script execution to confirm streaming logs update the frontend progressively.
Verify logs stream without delay and frontend UI updates smoothly.

title: Optimistic UI Updates and Session Persistence
description: Verify optimistic updates provide instant UI feedback during script generation and execution, and session state persists across page reloads.

steps.description: Start script generation and verify optimistic UI changes show progress immediately.
Verify UI updates optimistically before actual backend response.
Reload the page during or after script execution.
Verify previous session state (file selection, generated script, results) is restored correctly.

title: Error Handling for Invalid File Formats and Backend Failures
description: Verify that invalid file uploads and backend failures are handled gracefully with informative error messages and without frontend crashes.

steps.description: Upload a corrupted or unsupported file format.
Verify error message is clearly shown and user can retry with valid input.
Simulate backend inspect API failure.
Verify frontend shows appropriate error notification and remains usable.
Simulate script generation backend error.
Verify error handling UI provides retry or cancel options.
Simulate execution environment failure or timeout.
Verify error logs are captured and frontend indicates failure state cleanly.
